project_name: Steam Style Online Casino & CS2 Upgrader Shell
persona: E1 Creative Designer - Steam Platform Aesthetic & CS2 Upgrader Fusion

design_philosophy.core_concept: Authentic Valve Steam Client & Store visual language meets CS2 Item Upgrader UI shell.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Gamer-centric, high-trust, sleek industrial UI, tactical, high precision.
key_layout_sections: Header: Steam top dark header bar (#171a21) with official Steam-style logo, Navigation links (МАГАЗИН, СООБЩЕСТВО, О НАС, ПОДДЕРЖКА), language/install button, User Profile Block (Avatar, Steam Nickname, Balance display 'Баланс: 1,250.00 ₽', 'Пополнить' green button, notifications icon).

Main Content Div (Основа сайта): Dark blue gradient container background (#1b2838 to #171a21), ambient blue glow, placeholder canvas area for upcoming game modes (Upgrader, Case Opening, Wheel, Coinflip) with futuristic CS2 HUD card placeholders and mode switcher tabs.

Footer (Подвал сайта): Steam copyright section (#171a21 / #111417), Valve / Steam legal disclaimers, Valve logo, Steam logo, quick links, payment processor icons (Mir, Visa, MasterCard, Crypto, SBP), 18+ badge, CS2 skin rarity indicator accents.

sizes.section_title: text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#66c0f4]
sizes.nav_item: text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#c6d4df] hover:text-[#1a9fff]

visual_enhancers: Steam-style top linear gradient border with glowing blue accent line
Backdrop blur (#171a21 with 80% opacity and 12px blur for fixed sub-header)
Custom scrollbar styled in Steam dark blue (#1b2838 thumb, #101822 track)
Subtle ambient glow around active tabs and CS2 HUD element cards
Radial gradient lighting in background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%, rgba(26, 159, 255, 0.08), transparent 70%)

grids_and_layouts.header_layout: Fixed / Sticky header with top utility bar + main Steam nav grid (Logo left, Nav center-left, Profile & Balance block right)
grids_and_layouts.main_container: Max width 1200px centered container with p-4 md:p-8, structured layout with Mode Tabs at top, central empty interactive canvas placeholder, item drop ticker at top/side
grids_and_layouts.footer_layout: Full width dark container with 3-column link grid, Valve & Steam style disclaimer text, payment icons row, and live server status ping

components_to_build.name: SteamHeader
components_to_build.description: Full Steam header with logo, Russian nav links, language selector, Steam login button or Logged-In Profile block with avatar badge, username, balance in RUB, and green 'Пополнить' button.

components_to_build.name: LiveDropBar
components_to_build.description: Horizontal ticker displaying recently upgraded / won CS2 items with rarity color borders and live user avatars.

components_to_build.name: MainContentShell
components_to_build.description: The central section (Основа сайта) containing mode selection cards (Апгрейдер, Кейсы, Колесо, Дуэли), active mode placeholder div with steam gradient backdrop, slot drop zones, and quick inventory panel.

components_to_build.name: SteamFooter
components_to_build.description: Replicated Steam / Upgrader footer with copyright disclaimers, payment methods (SBP, Mir, Crypto, Visa), social links (Telegram, VK, Discord), and Steam API affiliation note.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, mode tabs, profile actions, and footer links MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the visual aesthetic matches Steam exactly: deep dark blues (#171a21, #1b2838), bright electric blue text/accents (#66c0f4, #1a9fff), and vibrant green action buttons (#a4d007 / #5c7e10 background).
Use Russian UI text everywhere as specified (МАГАЗИН, СООБЩЕСТВО, О НАС, ПОДДЕРЖКА, Баланс: 1,250.00 ₽, Пополнить, Вход через Steam, Апгрейдер предметов CS2, etc.).
Build the 3 major areas explicitly requested: 1) Шапка сайта (Header), 2) Основа сайта (Main Div Placeholder), 3) Подвал сайта (Footer).
Include a live drop ticker bar showing CS2 skins with rarity borders (Covert red, Classified purple, etc.) to give the authentic Upgrader vibe.
Do not use generic white or standard bright gradients. Maintain Steam's industrial dark steel and glowing neon blue atmosphere.
Make sure all files created are JavaScript (.js) as required by project conventions.
